name: Fossil Fighters: Champions TCG (Refactored)
customHelp:
Welcome to the Fossil Fighters TCG Project! This Project is a fan-made TCG based on the Nintendo DS game of the same name. More to be added after further testing!Welcome to the Fossil Fighters TCG Project! This Project is a fan-made TCG based on the Nintendo DS game of the same name. 

Let's go over how to start the game:

Each player begins the game by placing their whole hand at the bottom of their deck using the Bottom of deck option on the right side of their entire hand and then choosing 1 Vivosaur from their Deck to place into their Starter Vivosaur zone, face down. You do this by right-clicking your deck and choosing "Search", then picking a Vivosaur in your Deck and adding it to your hand; afterwards, you right-click the card. Select the "Visibility" option and choose "No one"; this will make the card flip facedown. afterwards, drag and drop the Vivosaur into your middle Vivosaur Zone, aka your "Starter Vivosaur Zone". 

After each player has placed their Vivosaurs face down, players determine turn order by a dice roll. You can do this by using the dice icon on the left side bar. After the turn order is determined, shuffle your Deck by right-clicking your deck and using the shuffling option, and go into the "connect with other players and manage turn orders" tab on the left side. Go to the "players and spectators" tab and choose who becomes the first turn player. Then, both players draw 4 cards by left-clicking on the deck to draw 1 card, then you flip their Starter Vivosaur face-up by left-clicking on the Vivosaur and choosing the "Visible by" option and choosing all.

Now, let's go over how the base gameplay for Fossil Fighters TCG:

Victory Conditions:
•Get 3 KO Points by defeating 3 of your Opponent's Vivosaurs 
•Your opponent cannot draw a card(s) when they are supposed to
•Your opponent has no remaining Vivosaurs in their Vivosaur Zones

A game progresses in a series of turns, which are divided into phases; many phases have a lot of different actions that make them different from phase to phase!

Draw Phase
This is the first phase of your turn. The player whose turn it is (the turn player) draws 1 card from the top of their Deck by left-clicking the top of their Deck. Afterwards, you can move to the Recharge Phase.

Recharge Phase
At the start of this phase, all Vivosaurs that were rested are no longer rested(A rested Vivosaur is rotated 90 degrees, which will be explained later). Next, take the top 3 cards of your FP Deck, which is on the left side of your playing field. You place these into your FP Zone by clicking and dragging the FP Cards into your FP Zone Face-up, then count how many Vivosaurs your opponent controls. After you have that number, add that number to your "counter tracker" on the lower left side of your screen next to your name; this is your "Action Points". We will explain these later on. Now, you can move to the Action Phase.

Action Phase
This is when you play most of your cards. All the listed actions can be done in any order you want, but most actions have restrictions:
•Once: you can play 1 Vivosaur from your hand into your Vivosaur zone, face-up. You can do this by left-clicking and dragging your Vivosaur card into one of your unoccupied Vivosaur zones.
•Once: You can swap the Vivosaur Zone of a Vivosaur with another Vivosaur Zone adjacent to it. If a Vivosaur is in that other zone, it is placed into that other zone. You swap your Vivosaurs by left-clicking and dragging the Vivosaurs into the zone you want to swap. 
•Once: You can place 1 Vivosaur from your hand into your FP Zone Face-up as an FP Charge Card. This card could be used to pay the FP costs of your Skills and Action cards. You can do this by dragging the Vivosaur into your FP Zone.
•You can play Action cards from your Hand by spending the required FP and using an Action Point. You play Action cards by placing the card into the right side section called "pile". After you are finished using the effect of the card, click the "play" button underneath the card, and it will be moved to your Discard Pile, which is next to your Deck.
•Each of your unrested Vivosaurs can use a Skill during this turn, unless it is the first turn of the game. You use a skill by rotating your Vivosaur sideways by left-clicking the card and paying the FP for the Skill you are using. This is known as "Resting" your Vivosaur. Rested Vivosaurs cannot use Skills.

After you are done with your Action Phase, you will proceed to the End Phase

End Phase
Announce the end of your turn, and if you have more than 6 cards in your hand at the end of this phase, select and discard cards in your Hand to your Discard Pile until you have 6 cards in your hand. Then it is your Opponent’s Turn!!
